ilk_kelime.title: First word
ilk_kelime.text: {ad} said their first word today! Everyone claims it was their own name.

options.result: {anne} couldn't hold back the tears.
{baba} called every relative.
Everyone at home laughed. The ball never leaves your hands.

ilk_adim.title: First steps
ilk_adim.text: Holding on to the coffee table, you took your first steps. How should your family encourage you?

options.text: Take you on lots of walks
options.result: The parks became yours.

options.text: Set up a safe play area
options.result: You started exploring your own corner.

oyuncak.title: Birthday present
oyuncak.text: Your family is choosing a birthday present for you. Which one will you reach for?

options.result: Not a single vase survived at home.
You made them read the same book a hundred times.
Towers, bridges, castles…
The walls got their share too.
There was never a day without a concert at home.

anaokulu.title: Kindergarten
anaokulu.text: First day of kindergarten. Some kids are crying at the door.

options.text: Give your toy to a crying child
options.result: You made your first friend.

options.text: Run straight to the coloring table
options.result: Your teacher pinned your drawing on the board.
The second day went easier.

ates.title: High fever
ates.text: One night your fever rose to 39 °C. Your family rushed you to the doctor.

options.result: You recovered in a few days.

kardes_dogdu.title: A new sibling
kardes_dogdu.text: A tiny sibling arrived home. Now the attention will be shared.

options.text: Act like a big sibling and help
options.result: Your sibling's first smile was for you.
Over time you learned to love your sibling.

dede_hikaye.title: Grandpa's stories
dede_hikaye.text: Your grandpa tells stories of the old days: fields, markets, hard years.

options.result: "A true merchant keeps their word."
You listened to the language of the land.
You listened until you fell asleep.

bocek.title: Garden discovery
bocek.text: You found a ladybug in the garden. You're counting its spots.

options.result: Your first scientific observation!
You colored all seven spots one by one.

tablet.title: Tablet or playground?
tablet.text: While visiting, they want to keep you busy with a tablet.

options.result: You learned letters and numbers through a game.

options.text: Play outside with the other kids
options.result: You came back sweaty but happy.

yetenek_parlama.title: Something was noticed
yetenek_parlama.text: A relative stopped while watching you: "There's something about this child…"

options.result: Your talents will show themselves in time. Try different things!

okuma_yazma.title: Reading and writing
okuma_yazma.text: You put letters together and read your first sentence: "Sam, throw the ball."

options.result: Car trips are more fun now.
Your first book: 3 pages, lots of pictures.

kayip_cuzdan.title: A wallet on the ground
kayip_cuzdan.text: You found a wallet full of money on the street. There's an ID inside.

options.text: Find the owner and return it
options.result: The owner was deeply moved; you became known as honest in the neighborhood.

options.text: Take it to the police station
options.result: The officer congratulated you.

zorbalik.title: Bullying at school
zorbalik.text: Someone in your class is forcing a younger kid to hand over their lunch.

options.result: The teacher handled it; the younger kid thanked you.
When you spoke up, others joined you. The bully backed off.
It stayed on your mind that night. Next time you won't stay silent.

zorbalik_hedef.title: You're the target
zorbalik_hedef.text: A few kids are mocking you and hiding your things.

options.text: Tell your family and the school counselor
options.result: The school acted right away. You saw you're not alone.

options.text: Find a new group of friends
options.result: You found people who like you at the chess club.

ogretmen_ilgi.title: Your teacher noticed you
ogretmen_ilgi.text: Your teacher loved a question you asked in class and called you over at break.

options.text: Ask for an extra reading list
options.result: You now have the 'Ask the teacher' lifeline in exams.

options.text: Ask for help with a project
options.result: You now have the 'Ask the teacher' lifeline in exams.

kutuphane.title: Library card
kutuphane.text: The neighborhood library is holding a summer reading challenge.

options.result: You got your medal at the end of summer.
There wasn't a street you didn't explore by bike.

sokak_kedisi.title: Injured cat
sokak_kedisi.text: On the way to school you found a cat with an injured paw.

options.text: Ask your family to help take it to the vet
options.result: You named the cat 'Snowball'; now it's always at your door.
The next day the cat was waiting for you.

satranc.title: Chess tournament
satranc.text: There's a chess tournament at school. Will you join?

options.result: You made it to the quarterfinals.
Next time you'll play too.
You wrote letters to each other for years.
Distance didn't end the friendship.

bilim_senligi.title: Science fair
bilim_senligi.text: You need to prepare an experiment for the school science fair.

options.success: The bulb lit up and the hall applauded!
options.fail: The bulb didn't light, but you explained why; the judges liked that too.

options.result: The foaming lava made everyone laugh.

mahalle_turnuva.title: Neighborhood tournament final
mahalle_turnuva.text: The neighborhood tournament final! The score is tied in the last minute. You have the ball.

options.success: Goal! They carried you on their shoulders.
options.fail: It hit the post. The match was lost on penalties, but you played great.

options.result: Your friend scored, and you were the first one they hugged.

bakkal_amca.title: The corner shop owner
bakkal_amca.text: The corner shop owner gave you too much change.

options.text: Go back and return the extra
options.result: "You'll make a fine shopkeeper one day," he said, and gave you a chocolate.

karne_hediye.title: Report card present
karne_hediye.text: Your family wants to buy you a present for your honors certificate.

options.result: You felt the wind on your face.
The kitchen turned into a lab.
Your piggy bank got heavier.

koy_hasat.title: Harvest time
koy_hasat.text: The whole village is out for the harvest. Everyone is helping.

options.text: Go out to the fields too
options.success: The crop was brought in on time; the elders praised you.
options.fail: Some of the crop rotted, but you learned a lot.

options.result: You carried drinks to everyone in the fields.

sehir_kurs.title: Weekend workshop
sehir_kurs.text: The city is opening free weekend workshops.

options.result: Your line-following robot finished the course.
You overcame stage fright.
A wonky but lovely vase for your mom.

izci.title: A scout at the match
izci.text: Someone in the stands is taking notes. A big club's scout is watching you.

options.success: The scout came over: "Come to the club on Monday." The academy gate opened!
options.fail: Nerves made you miss a few chances. The scout left a card: "Keep working."

options.success: The risky tricks worked! The scout was impressed. You're in the academy!
options.fail: Showing off didn't work. The scout shook his head and left. Lesson learned.

izci_aile.title: Your family's decision
izci_aile.text: The club's facilities are far away. Your family has to decide.

options.result: New home, new school, new life. You're at training every day.
The trips are tiring, but you're determined.

u17_cagri.title: U17 national team call-up
u17_cagri.text: The phone rang: the U17 national team is inviting you to camp!

options.success: You scored the penalty in the friendly. You wore the national jersey!
options.fail: You didn't make the squad, but the coaches starred your name.

okul_secme.title: School team tryouts
okul_secme.text: The PE teacher is holding tryouts for the school team.

options.success: You're on the team! Your shirt number is 10.
options.fail: Not this time. Keep practicing in street games.

options.result: You focused on other things.

sinif_baskani.title: Class president election
sinif_baskani.text: There's a class president election. Will you run?

options.success: You won! Your first act: a class library.
options.fail: You lost by a small margin, but the class listened to you.

options.result: Your friend won and you became vice president.

kopya_rica.title: Your friend needs help
kopya_rica.text: Before tomorrow's test, {arkadas} is very worried: "I didn't understand anything."

options.result: You studied together and both got good grades. Now you have a study group.

options.text: Ask the teacher for extra help
options.result: The teacher gave you both extra study sessions.

calisma_grubu.title: Study group
calisma_grubu.text: A study group is forming in class. Two evenings a week.

options.result: The 'Study group' lifeline is now unlocked in exams.
You like your own pace.

dolandirici_mesaj.title: "Congratulations, you won!"
dolandirici_mesaj.text: You got a message: "You've won a phone! Enter your card details."

options.text: Delete it and warn your family and friends
options.result: It was a phishing attack. You warned a friend too.
Money was taken from your account. You called the bank; be careful next time!

ekran_bagimliligi.title: Glued to the screen
ekran_bagimliligi.text: You realized you spend 6 hours a day on your phone.

options.result: Your sleep improved and your energy went up.
Your eyes are tired and your mind scattered.

bilim_olimpiyati.title: Science olympiad
bilim_olimpiyati.text: You were selected for the national science olympiad! The final exam is very hard.

options.success: Bronze medal! A university scholarship is in your pocket.
options.fail: No medal, but even reaching the final is a big achievement.

harclik_birikim.title: Piggy bank
harclik_birikim.text: Some of your allowance is left over.

options.text: Put it in the piggy bank
options.result: Saving feels good.

options.text: Buy ice cream for your friends
options.result: Everyone will remember you that summer.

bisiklet_tamir.title: Flat tire
bisiklet_tamir.text: Your bike has a flat tire.

options.success: The patch held. You're now the neighborhood bike mechanic.
options.fail: You had a part left over. The mechanic showed you where it went.

options.text: Take it to the repair shop
options.result: The mechanic showed you how it's done.

sinav_kaygisi.title: Exam anxiety
sinav_kaygisi.text: As the big exam gets closer, you can't sleep.

options.result: Breathing exercises and a study plan helped.
Your head cleared and your focus improved.
You know more, but you're exhausted.

ilk_ask.title: First love
ilk_ask.text: Someone from class left you a note at break. Your heart is pounding.

options.result: First love… never forgotten.
Maybe it's not the time.

rehberlik.title: Career guidance
rehberlik.text: The school counselor wants to review your talents with you.

options.result: The results gave hints about where you could shine (Me tab).

proje_yarismasi.title: Project competition win
proje_yarismasi.text: You reached the final of the national science project competition. You must demonstrate your system in front of the jury.

options.success: First place! An award, a scholarship and your photo in the papers.
options.fail: The system froze at the last moment, but the jury gave your idea an honorable mention.

yurtdisi_burs.title: Scholarship abroad
yurtdisi_burs.text: Thanks to your grades you won a scholarship to a summer school abroad.

options.result: A new language, a new world.
Your family was very happy with your decision.

mentor_ogretmen.title: A mentor
mentor_ogretmen.text: A well-known figure wants to mentor you. Which field will you choose?

options.result: Your football growth is 20% faster.
Your science growth is 20% faster.
Your business growth is 20% faster.
Your technology growth is 20% faster.

sakatlik_genc.title: Injury
sakatlik_genc.text: You twisted your knee at training. The doctor says to rest.

options.result: You fully recovered; patience paid off.
A risky decision…

fenomen.title: Your video went viral
fenomen.text: A video you posted got a million views overnight!

options.result: Your followers love you, and a little ad income started.
The attention faded fast. Your grades slipped.

deprem_tatbikati.title: Earthquake drill
deprem_tatbikati.text: There's an earthquake drill at school/work. Most people aren't taking it seriously.

options.text: Take it seriously and learn the exits
options.result: You prepared an emergency kit. You'll be better off in a real earthquake.
The drill ended.

kulup_kur.title: Start a club
kulup_kur.text: Your school has no coding, music or nature club. What if you started one?

options.result: 23 people came to the first meeting!

options.text: Let someone else start it; you join
options.result: You made a great team.

yaz_isi.title: Summer job offer
yaz_isi.text: The ice cream shop on the beach is hiring for the summer.

options.success: You ran the register all summer; the boss invited you back next year.
options.fail: The till came up short a few times, but you learned a lot.

options.result: Batteries recharged.

ilk_maas.title: First paycheck
ilk_maas.text: Your first paycheck hit your account!

options.text: Buy a gift for your family
options.result: The smile on {anne}'s face was worth everything.
You planted a small seed for the future.

sahte_ilan.title: Rental listing
sahte_ilan.text: You found a very cheap apartment for rent. The owner says: "I'm abroad; send the deposit and I'll mail you the key."

options.text: Don't send money without seeing it
options.result: Right call! The listing was a scam.
No apartment, no owner. You went to the police. A painful lesson.

universite_kulup.title: Campus life
universite_kulup.text: Club fair day. The stands are full of color.

options.result: You found your first business idea here.
Your first summit!
You took books to village schools.

burs_basvuru.title: Scholarship application
burs_basvuru.text: A foundation offers scholarships to top students. You were invited to an interview.

options.success: You won the scholarship! Your living costs are halved.
options.fail: Not this term. You can apply again next term.

evlilik_teklifi.title: Marriage
evlilik_teklifi.text: You and {partner} have been together for years. Is it time to share your lives?

options.result: "Yes!" You joined your lives with a simple, warm wedding.
{partner} was a bit hurt but understood.

cocuk_istegi.title: Growing the family?
cocuk_istegi.text: You and {partner} are talking about having children.

options.result: A little miracle entered your life.
Career and home first.
The house came alive!
You give them all your love.

kredi_karti.title: Credit card offer
kredi_karti.text: The bank offers a high-limit credit card. Buy-now-pay-later is at the door.

options.result: The card made life easier, and you didn't go into debt.

options.text: Buy a new phone and clothes
options.result: The installments lasted for months…

ortaklik_teklifi.title: Partnership offer
ortaklik_teklifi.text: An old friend wants to open a café and asks you to be a partner. No business plan, but lots of enthusiasm.

options.text: Ask for a business plan and numbers first
options.result: Once the plan was done you saw the numbers didn't work; the friendship and the money stayed safe.
The dice are cast…

startup.title: Startup idea
startup.text: The app you built caught the eye of an accelerator. Demo day is tomorrow!

options.success: You got funded! You built a small team and grew the product.
options.fail: A bug appeared during the demo. The investors said to come back in a year.

ilk_araba.title: Used car
ilk_araba.text: You found an affordable used car.

options.result: It checked out. Now you're on the road every weekend.
Your savings keep growing.

ev_alma.title: Owning a home
ev_alma.text: Your savings are enough for a down payment on a home.

options.result: No more rent — the key is yours!

options.text: Keep renting and invest in your work
options.result: You kept your cash strong.

ekonomik_kriz.title: Economic crisis
ekonomik_kriz.text: The currency collapsed and markets froze. Everyone is wondering what to do.

options.result: It was a hard year, but you came through solid.
A bold move…
You protected your staff and cut costs.

deprem.title: Earthquake
deprem.text: 4:17 am. The ground shook. The street is full of dust. Voices come from the rubble.

options.success: You pulled a family from the rubble. The neighborhood calls you a "People's Hero".
options.fail: You did all you could. When the teams arrived, you collapsed from exhaustion.

options.text: Move your family to safety and gather aid
options.result: You handed out blankets and water at the assembly area.

kayip_akraba.title: Lost relative
kayip_akraba.text: A letter arrived: you have an uncle your father never mentioned, and he wants to meet you.

options.result: An old man whose eyes look like yours…
You put the letter in a drawer.

kayip_akraba2.title: Family secret
kayip_akraba2.text: Your uncle tells you about a fight from years ago. He asks for your help to make peace.

options.success: After years, the two brothers embraced.
options.fail: The hurt ran deep. But you opened a door.

kayip_akraba3.title: Your uncle's will
kayip_akraba3.text: Your uncle passed away. In his will he left you an old olive grove and a letter: "For bringing the family together."

options.result: The olive trees bore fruit again.

options.text: Donate it to the village school
options.result: The school now bears your uncle's name.

ebeveyn_vefat.title: Farewell
ebeveyn_vefat.text: After a long and full life, one of your parents passed away.

options.result: What they taught you stays with you.

hastalik.title: Health problem
hastalik.text: You've been tired for a while. The doctor wants some tests.

options.text: Get tested and start treatment now
options.result: Thanks to early diagnosis, you got through it easily.
The illness progressed and treatment took long.

bel_agrisi.title: Back pain
bel_agrisi.text: Hours at the desk have worn out your back.

options.result: The pain eased and your energy rose.
The pain faded for a while.

orta_yas.title: The question in the mirror
orta_yas.text: One morning you looked in the mirror and wondered: "Is this the life I dreamed of?"

options.result: Guitar lessons began.
Family dinners became sacred.
A new motivation.

vergi_denetimi.title: Tax audit
vergi_denetimi.text: A tax inspector wants to review your books.

options.result: Your books were spotless. You made the trusted-business list.

fazla_odeme.title: The customer's mistake
fazla_odeme.text: A customer accidentally paid twice and didn't notice.

options.result: The customer was so impressed they brought their friends.

sahte_tedarikci.title: Fake supplier
sahte_tedarikci.text: A new supplier is selling at half the market price. They want cash up front and won't give invoices.

options.text: Notice the red flags and stay away
options.result: A few weeks later the supplier turned out to be a fraud. You were safe.
The goods never came. A small loss, a big lesson.

rakip_karalama.title: A rival's smear
rakip_karalama.text: A rival shop is posting fake reviews about your products on social media.

options.result: Your customers defended you.
The reviews were taken down.

yatirimci.title: An investor noticed your shop
yatirimci.text: A well-known investor offers big capital for 30% of your business.

options.success: You got a good valuation. Fuel for growth is ready!
options.fail: You settled at a low valuation, but the capital still came in.

options.result: You chose to grow at your own pace.

unlu_urun.title: A celebrity used your product
unlu_urun.text: A famous actor shared your product. Orders are exploding!

options.success: You shipped every order on time for three months. You became a brand!
options.fail: Stock ran out and some orders were late. You still earned well.

toptan_firsat.title: Bulk order
toptan_firsat.text: A hotel chain wants to place a bulk order but expects a discount.

options.success: You made a profitable deal!
options.fail: Your margin dropped a lot, but you won a customer.

options.result: You focused on your existing customers.

tarla_eser.title: Ancient find in the field
tarla_eser.text: While driving the tractor, an old amphora surfaced from the soil.

options.text: Hand it over to the authorities
options.result: The museum gave you a reward; your name was in the local paper.

options.text: Donate it and help with the dig
options.result: The dig uncovered an ancient farmhouse. A documentary was made about it.

dolu.title: Hailstorm
dolu.text: Hail fell a week before the harvest.

options.result: The insurance covered the loss.

options.text: Save what's left of the crop
options.success: You saved half the crop.
options.fail: The damage is big. You should get insurance next year.

tarim_sigortasi.title: Crop insurance
tarim_sigortasi.text: The cooperative is explaining state-backed crop insurance.

options.result: You're now protected against natural disasters.
Hope the weather smiles on you.

kooperatif.title: Start a cooperative?
kooperatif.text: The village farmers sell their crops to traders far too cheaply. What if you united?

options.success: The village united; the crops now go straight to the market.
options.fail: You couldn't convince everyone. Try again next year.

zor_vaka.title: A tough case
zor_vaka.text: A patient with confusing symptoms came into the ER. The other doctors aren't sure.

options.success: Correct diagnosis! The patient recovered and wrote you a thank-you letter.
options.fail: A consultation led to the right diagnosis. You learned something new.

nobet.title: Night shift
nobet.text: You're on call on a holiday night. The ER is packed.

options.success: Critical patients were treated first. The chief physician congratulated you.
options.fail: It was a hard night; some patients waited a long time.

koprü_proje.title: New project
koprü_proje.text: The company entrusted you with a key client's system.

options.success: The project was delivered on time; you got a bonus!
options.fail: You were a few days late, but it finally worked.

usulsuz_teklif.title: Improper offer
usulsuz_teklif.text: A company offers you a "gift" if you favor them in a tender.

options.text: Refuse and report it to your manager
options.result: It became a model case for the company's ethics board. Your integrity was confirmed.
You drew your lines clearly.

gece_bug.title: Midnight bug
gece_bug.text: The live system crashed! It's 2 am and your phone is ringing.

options.success: You fixed it in 15 minutes. The team calls you the 'firefighter'.
options.fail: You worked until morning, but you solved it.

derbi.title: Derby day
derbi.text: Derby! The stadium is packed. You won a last-minute penalty.

options.success: GOAL! The stands are chanting your name.
options.fail: The keeper saved it. You're in the headlines the next day… but your team has your back.

options.result: The captain scored, and you were the first one they hugged.

transfer_teklifi.title: Transfer offer
transfer_teklifi.text: Another club is offering a higher salary. Your agent suggests negotiating.

options.success: A signing bonus in your pocket!
options.fail: You didn't reach your number, but you agreed.

options.result: The fans won't forget your loyalty.

zor_ariza.title: The fault nobody could fix
zor_ariza.text: An engine that stumped everyone in the industrial area came to your workshop.

options.success: It was a gasket! Your name is on everyone's lips.
options.fail: Your master showed you; you'll never forget it.

cirak_yetistir.title: New apprentice
cirak_yetistir.text: A new apprentice joined the workshop; very eager but clumsy.

options.result: Years later that apprentice will speak of you as 'my master'.
Things go fast but it's exhausting.

veli_toplantisi.title: Parent-teacher meeting
veli_toplantisi.text: Your child's teacher wants to talk with you.

options.text: Get involved and help with homework
options.result: Your child's grades went up.

options.text: Too busy with work to go
options.result: Next time you'll definitely go.

cocuk_hastalik.title: Your child is sick
cocuk_hastalik.text: Your child's fever won't go down.

options.text: Take time off and stay by their side
options.result: They recovered in a few days and hugged you for being there.

torun.title: Grandchild
torun.text: Great news from your child: you're going to be a grandparent!

options.result: Life's most beautiful title.

emeklilik_partisi.title: Farewell party
emeklilik_partisi.text: Your coworkers threw you a surprise farewell party.

options.result: Everyone wiped away tears.

ani_kitabi.title: Write your memoirs
ani_kitabi.text: Your grandchildren want you to write down your stories.

options.result: Your book is sold in local bookstores.

options.text: Tell them aloud and let them record
options.result: A priceless recording for the family archive.

eski_dost.title: An old friend
eski_dost.text: You ran into {arkadas}, whom you hadn't seen in years.

options.result: It's as if you'd never been apart.

miras_planı.title: Estate plan
miras_planı.text: Your lawyer asks how you want to divide your estate.

options.text: Split it fairly among your children
options.result: Family peace is secured.

options.text: Donate part to a scholarship fund
options.result: A scholarship fund was created in your name.

dunya_turu.title: World tour
dunya_turu.text: There's a chance for the world tour you've always dreamed of.

options.result: From Machu Picchu to Cappadocia… memories too big for the album.

options.text: Leave the money to the grandchildren
options.result: Their future is your happiness.

genclere_mentor.title: Mentoring young people
genclere_mentor.text: A university asks you to give students a career talk.

options.success: The hall gave you a standing ovation. Three students emailed you afterwards.
options.fail: You were a bit nervous, but the students showed interest with their questions.

komsu_yardim.title: The neighbor's trouble
komsu_yardim.text: Your elderly neighbor has no one to carry their shopping.

options.result: Your neighbor loves you like a grandchild.
They now get regular support.

dogum_gunu.title: Surprise birthday
dogum_gunu.text: Your friends threw you a surprise birthday party!

options.result: You blew out the candles and made a wish.

evcil_hayvan.title: A stray dog
evcil_hayvan.text: There's a dog at the shelter looking at you.

options.result: Now you go for a walk together every morning.
Food and medicine were bought.

burnout.title: Burnout
burnout.text: Getting out of bed in the morning is hard. Nothing feels enjoyable.

options.result: Talking helped. You're slowly recovering.

options.text: Take time off and go into nature
options.result: The mountain air cleared your head.

options.text: Cover it with a lid and turn off the stove
options.result: Right move! The fire went out.
The flames grew and the fire brigade came. Never pour water on an oil fire.

gonullu_ogretmen.title: Village school
gonullu_ogretmen.text: A charity is looking for weekend volunteer teachers for village schools.

options.result: The children's curiosity inspired you too.
The school library grew.

yarışma_tv.title: Quiz show
yarışma_tv.text: You were chosen for a TV quiz show! You reached the final question.

options.success: The grand prize is yours! Knowledge is earned through effort.
options.fail: You got stuck on the last question but went home with a nice prize.

options.result: A wise decision.

hayir_kermesi.title: School charity fair
hayir_kermesi.text: There's a charity fair at school for students in need.

options.text: Open a stall and sell cookies
options.success: Your stall raised the most donations!
options.fail: The accounts got a bit mixed up, but the donation goal was reached.

options.result: Your poster was the talk of the school.

muzik_yarismasi.title: Music competition
muzik_yarismasi.text: You have a chance to enter the city music competition.

options.success: You won first place! A studio got in touch.
options.fail: You missed a note, but the jury saw your potential.

resim_sergisi.title: First exhibition
resim_sergisi.text: A gallery wants to exhibit your work.

options.success: Your painting sold!
options.fail: The show drew little interest, but the first step is taken.

aile_fatura.title: Bills are piling up
aile_fatura.text: The electricity and gas bills went unpaid; a disconnection notice arrived. {anne} is doing sums late into the night. The mood at home is heavy.
aile_fatura.log: The family couldn't pay the bills.

options.text: Give all my savings to my family
options.result: {anne} hugged you: "You're our pride."
You promised. Find work at the market or in the neighborhood and give your earnings to the family — or the problems will grow.
You closed your door, but the silence behind the walls gets heavier every night.

options.text: Say you don't want your allowance
options.result: A big help from small hands.

options.text: Quietly sense the tension at home
options.result: You don't fully understand, but everyone is very tired.

aile_kira.title: Rent warning
aile_kira.text: The landlord sent a formal warning over unpaid rent. Either the debt is paid, or you move to a smaller home farther away.
aile_kira.log: The family received a rent warning.

options.text: Give all my savings so we keep our home
options.result: The rent was paid. Your family will never forget this sacrifice.

options.text: Let's move to a smaller home
options.result: The new home is cramped and school is farther. You see old friends less, but the family can breathe.
Your uncle lent the money. But one day it will have to be repaid.

options.text: Move to the new home with your family
options.result: The new home is small and school is far. You cried a little packing your things into boxes.

akraba_borc.title: The loan comes due
akraba_borc.text: The uncle who lent your family money years ago is now struggling himself. He asks for it back.

options.text: I'll repay the debt for my family
options.result: Your uncle thanked you with tears in his eyes. A promise is a bond.

options.text: Let's repay it in installments together
options.result: The installments will be tough, but the promise was kept.
A chill came between you and your uncle.

aile_icra.title: Debt collectors at the door
aile_icra.text: {baba}'s debts went to collection; the furniture is being seized. {kardes} is thinking of leaving school to work. Everyone is looking at you.
aile_icra.log: The family went through debt collection and seizures.

options.text: I'll leave school and work full-time
options.result: Life made you grow up early. But the road isn't over: you can finish an equivalency diploma later.

options.text: Keep going to school and work nights
options.result: School by day, warehouse by night. You're tired, but you carry both loads.
Your sibling started working at a factory. An ache stayed with you that never faded.

options.text: Tell your teacher about your fears
options.result: Your teacher arranged school supplies and clothes through the parents' association.

aile_dagilma.title: The family is falling apart
aile_dagilma.text: Debts, fights, doors that won't close… {anne} and {baba} are talking about separating.
aile_dagilma.log: The family reached a breaking point.

options.text: Sit them down and get them talking
options.success: That night, for the first time, everyone listened. You made a plan; the family held together.
options.fail: They started living in separate homes. Life goes on, but now you have two homes.

options.result: The counselor showed that the problem wasn't money but not talking.

options.text: Write your parents a letter: "Please stop fighting"
options.result: After reading it, both were silent for a long time. That evening they talked at the dinner table for the first time.

ebeveyn_zor.title: Your parents are struggling
ebeveyn_zor.text: Your parents are struggling to get by. Rent, medicine, bills… They were too proud to tell you.
ebeveyn_zor.log: Learned that their elderly parents were struggling financially.

options.result: Loyalty. For the first time in years, your father sounded relaxed on the phone.

options.text: Take them in and live together
options.result: The house got crowded; sometimes hard, but they share the table with their grandchildren.

options.text: I can't afford it right now
options.result: The call you hung up kept gnawing at you.

baba_isten_cikti.title: Your father lost his job
baba_isten_cikti.text: {baba}'s workplace downsized and your father was laid off. Household income dropped overnight.
baba_isten_cikti.log: Their father lost his job; the family's income dropped.

options.text: Cheer your father up and look at listings together
options.result: Your father smiled shyly: "I'm glad I have you."

options.text: Say you don't want your allowance
options.result: A small sacrifice, but the family noticed.
Don't forget to give what you earn from work to the family (Home tab).
Even if you don't fully understand, your hug gave him strength.

anne_hastalik.title: Your mother fell ill
anne_hastalik.text: {anne} fell ill. There are treatment costs, and for a while she can't work or do the housework.
anne_hastalik.log: Their mother went through a long illness.

options.text: Take on the chores and look after your siblings
options.result: For a year you were the pillar of the home. When your mother recovered, she thanked you first.

options.text: Stay with her at the hospital
options.result: You watched the doctors in the corridors. Maybe one day you too…

options.text: Draw your mother a picture to cheer her up
options.result: She put it by her bed: "The best medicine."

options.text: Be good and help with small things
options.result: You tidied your toys and set the table. Small, but precious.

kira_zammi.title: Huge rent increase
kira_zammi.text: The landlord wants to raise the rent by 60%. {baba} is thinking of negotiating.

options.success: You brought the increase down to a reasonable level!
options.fail: The landlord wouldn't budge. The budget got even tighter.

options.result: A little less left over every month.

baba_terfi.title: Good news at home
baba_terfi.text: {baba} and {anne} advanced at work; the household income rose.

options.result: Laughter at the table — the first easy year in a long time.

kardes_masraf.title: Your sibling got into university
kardes_masraf.text: {kardes} got into a university in another city. Dorm, travel, books… A new expense for the family.

options.text: Help out from your own savings
options.result: Your sibling got their first allowance from you.

options.text: Congratulate them and wish them well
options.result: The family is proud, but the budget will be tighter for four years.

dede_bakimi.title: Caring for grandpa
dede_bakimi.text: Your grandpa can no longer live alone; he's moving in with you. Both a joy and a responsibility.

options.text: Spend time with grandpa and look after him
options.result: Grandpa's stories became the most valuable lessons of your life.
You sleep in the living room, but you feel at peace.

akraba_yardim.title: A relative offers help
akraba_yardim.text: A well-off relative wants to help your family. {baba} hesitates out of pride.

options.result: The help came just in time.

options.text: We'll get through on our own
options.result: You chose an honorable but hard road.

okul_gezisi.title: School trip
okul_gezisi.text: There's a class museum trip, but your family can't afford the fee.

options.result: A trip paid for by your own effort meant more.

options.text: Don't go; don't burden your family
options.result: You smiled as your friends showed their photos, and made yourself a promise.
Your teacher covered it through the parents' association. Nothing to be ashamed of.

calisan_cocuk.title: Sunday morning
calisan_cocuk.text: While your classmates met at a café, you were counting the till at the market. One of them saw you.

options.text: Hold your head high: "I'm helping my family."
options.result: The next day they looked at you with respect.
Hard work is nothing to be ashamed of. You'll learn that in time.

zengin_baski.title: Family business pressure
zengin_baski.text: Your family sees your future in the family business. But you have other dreams.

options.result: Your family was upset but respected it.
You learned how the business really works.

modellik.title: Ad shoot offer
modellik.text: An agency spotted you on the street and invited you to an ad shoot.

options.result: Your face is on bus stops! Nice extra income.
You know your priorities.

ilk_izlenim.title: The room went quiet
ilk_izlenim.text: You spoke up at a meeting; everyone stopped talking to listen.

options.result: Your proposal was accepted. Charisma is inborn, but effort makes it shine.

dedikodu.title: Gossip
dedikodu.text: Some say your success is only thanks to your looks.

options.text: Show your work; let the results speak
options.result: The gossip stopped; your grades and your work spoke.
What people say doesn't define you.

ozguven.title: You in the mirror
ozguven.text: You looked in the mirror and didn't like what you saw. Everyone on social media looks perfect.

options.result: Taking care of yourself is a way of loving yourself.
Looks shape first impressions, but character keeps people by your side.

dogal_lider.title: They chose you as leader
dogal_lider.text: Your friends want you to lead the team for a new project.

options.text: Gather the team and explain the goal
options.success: The project was a success; everyone wants to work with you again.
options.fail: The team fell apart, but you learned leadership's first lesson: listening.

options.result: Maybe next time.

sahne_korkusu.title: Stage fright
sahne_korkusu.text: Your tongue ties when you have to speak in front of a crowd.

options.text: Sign up for theater or debate
options.result: Charisma is like a muscle: it grows with practice.

options.text: Avoid it and stay in the back row
options.result: Comfortable, but a small world.

es_terfi.title: {partner} got promoted!
es_terfi.text: {partner} got a big promotion at work. Household income is rising.

options.result: Each other's success is your shared success.

es_issiz.title: {partner} lost their job
es_issiz.text: {partner}'s company downsized; they'll be out of work for a while. The household budget is shaken.

options.text: Cheer them up and plan together
options.result: Hand in hand through hard times. Within a year they found a new job.
The chill at home lasted longer than the unemployment.

es_tartisma.title: Budget argument
es_tartisma.text: You and {partner} argued about money and time. Voices were raised.

options.text: Talk calmly and make a shared plan
options.success: The argument turned into a plan; your relationship grew stronger.
options.fail: Hurtful words came out again. It needs time.

options.result: You won the argument but lost ground in the relationship.

kayin_yardim.title: An offer from your in-laws
kayin_yardim.text: {partner}'s family offers major support to help you buy a home.

options.result: The key to your own home is in your hands. With your savings and their help you can become a homeowner.
An honorable decision; your partner was a little upset but respected it.
By candlelight, you talked about the day you first met.
When you got home, a lonely cake was waiting on the table…

es_savurgan.title: Credit card statement
es_savurgan.text: {partner} made a big purchase on the credit card. The statement is hefty.

options.result: The budget sheet is on the fridge door.
That silence could become a habit.

es_destek.title: Someone by your side
es_destek.text: At the end of a hard week, {partner} was waiting with warm soup and a listening ear.

options.result: Marrying the right person is one of life's best decisions.

es_macera.title: Weekend adventure
es_macera.text: {partner} planned a camping trip for the weekend!

options.result: Two days under the stars, no phones.
The camping bag waited until next spring.

fazla_mesai_istegi.title: The boss's request
fazla_mesai_istegi.text: Your boss wants you to work overtime this weekend. But you'd made plans with your family.

options.result: The bonus is in your pocket, but a chair stayed empty at the table.
Life isn't only about work.

veli_cagri.title: The teacher called your parents
veli_cagri.text: It was noticed that you haven't studied at all for two years. Your teacher called {anne} and {baba} to school. The ride home is very quiet.
veli_cagri.log: Parents were called in for neglecting studies.

options.text: Admit it and make a study plan
options.result: Your teacher gave you extra materials. Study this year and you can close the gap.
A wall went up between you and your family. If your grades keep falling you may repeat the year.

sinifta_kaldin.title: You repeated a grade
sinifta_kaldin.text: Your friends moved up a grade; you're in the same one. Your new classmates are a year younger.

options.text: Let it be a lesson: start fresh
options.result: Seeing the topics a second time, most things clicked. A lost year can become a gained habit.
You didn't talk to anyone for a while. But life is long; recovery is possible.

hareketsiz_yasam.title: Sedentary life
hareketsiz_yasam.text: You've barely moved for three years. You're out of breath on the stairs, and the doctor warned: "Keep this up and your health is at serious risk."
hareketsiz_yasam.log: Got a doctor's warning about an inactive lifestyle.

options.result: The first week was hard, then it became a habit. Don't neglect sports activities!
Those who never find time for health will one day have to make time for illness.

yalnizlik.title: Loneliness
yalnizlik.text: Your phone doesn't ring. No one remembered your birthday. You realize you haven't made time for friends in years.
yalnizlik.log: Went through a period of loneliness.

options.result: "Where have you been?!" Their voice hasn't changed. Friendship takes effort.
New faces, new stories.
Loneliness becomes a habit; be careful.

aile_kopukluk.title: Drifting apart from family
aile_kopukluk.text: You haven't made time for your family in a long while. No one talks at dinner; {anne} is hurt. If you have kids, they now see you as someone who's "always busy".

options.text: Give a whole weekend to your family
options.result: At the picnic, everyone laughed for the first time in ages. Make family time a regular thing.
"When I'm done with work" is a day that never comes.

tukenmislik.title: Burnout
tukenmislik.text: No vacation, no rest for years. When the alarm rings, a weight settles on your chest; even your favorite things bring no joy.

options.text: Take leave, rest and see a professional
options.result: For the first time you listened to yourself. Resting is work too — important work.

options.text: Grit your teeth and push on
options.result: One day the body sends the bill. Don't neglect rest activities.

anne_vefat.title: You lost your mother
anne_vefat.text: The phone rang at night. {anne} has passed away. The warmest corner of the home is now empty.

options.text: Grieve and be strong for your family
options.result: What she taught you will light your way on the hardest days.

options.text: Bury your grief in study or work
options.result: You worked hard, but some nights your tears fell silently.
Your mother's voice is always with you in your dreams.

baba_vefat.title: You lost your father
baba_vefat.text: {baba} has passed away. Every time you walk in the door, you listen for his voice.

options.text: Grieve and be strong for your family
options.result: You promised to carry on your father's legacy.
You grew up early. Don't forget to give your earnings to the family (Home tab).

options.text: Hug your mother; be strong for each other
options.result: You were very young, but you'll never forget that day.

kardes_vefat.title: You lost your sibling
kardes_vefat.text: An accident, an illness… Your sibling has passed away. Your family is in deep mourning.

options.result: You held on to each other. Their memory is always with you.
The grief lasted long. Your friends and family are waiting for you.

es_vefat.title: You lost your spouse
es_vefat.text: {partner}, who shared your pillow for years, has passed away. The house is so quiet.

options.text: Hold on to your children and friends
options.result: Their memories live on in your grandchildren's stories.
Loneliness wears on the body too. Call your friends; you're not alone.

dede_vefat.title: You lost a grandparent
dede_vefat.text: The whole family gathered at your grandparent's funeral. You remembered their tales and prayers.

options.text: Write down their memories for your grandchildren
options.result: What you wrote became the family's memory.
Even feuding relatives made peace that day.

sut_disi.title: Your first tooth fell out
sut_disi.text: Your front tooth was wobbly, and it came out when you bit an apple!

options.result: In the morning there was a little surprise under your pillow.

options.text: Keep it in a box as a memento
options.result: Your first keepsake box.

bisiklet_ogren.title: Learning to ride a bike
bisiklet_ogren.text: {baba} is holding the back of the bike. "I won't let go," he says…

options.text: Pedal on, and get up if you fall
options.result: When you looked back, you saw your father had let go long ago. You were riding on your own!
You'll try again next year.

karanlik_korkusu.title: Fear of the dark
karanlik_korkusu.text: At night the shadow in the corner of your room looks like a monster.

options.text: Turn on the light and look
options.result: It was your coat on the chair! Facing your fear worked.
That night you slept soundly next to your mom.

teneffus_kavga.title: Argument at recess
teneffus_kavga.text: You and a friend are arguing about whose turn it is with the ball. It's about to escalate.

options.result: Everyone agreed and the game went on.
The game fell apart, and for a while no one played with you.

karne_gunu.title: Report card day
karne_gunu.text: You're coming home with your report card. {anne} is waiting at the door.

options.result: An evening full of praise.
"Thank you for telling the truth; we'll work on it together."
It turned up in your bag the next day. What upset them most was the hiding.

kayboldun.title: Lost in the crowd
kayboldun.text: You lost your mom at the shopping mall. It's very crowded.

options.text: Go to a staff member or a checkout
options.result: An announcement was made and your mom came running. You did the right thing!
They found you in the end, but you were very scared. When lost, going to a staff member is best.

hayvanat.title: School trip: the zoo
hayvanat.text: Your class went to the zoo. A giraffe is right in front of you!

options.result: You learned that giraffe tongues are purple!
Your notebook turned into an animal encyclopedia.

ilk_telefon.title: First phone
ilk_telefon.text: Your family got you your first phone. You'll set the rules together.

options.text: Agree to a daily time limit
options.result: The phone made life easier without taking it over.
The first weeks were great… then the homework piled up.

telefon_yok.title: Everyone has a phone
telefon_yok.text: Everyone in class has a phone; even homework groups are organized by message. You don't have one.

options.text: Save your allowance and buy a used one
options.result: The screen is scratched, but you bought it with your own effort.

options.text: Ask a friend to write the homework in your notebook
options.result: A true friend shows up in hard times.
A phone doesn't decide a person's worth.

oyun_bagimliligi.title: Just one more round…
oyun_bagimliligi.text: You played games until 3 am. In class your eyes keep closing.

options.result: You still enjoy games and your grades aren't slipping.
A habit is starting; be careful.

sivilce.title: Puberty
sivilce.text: Your voice is cracking and your face broke out. You don't want to look in the mirror.

options.result: It will pass. It did for everyone.

options.text: Talk to an adult you trust
options.result: You laughed when you saw your parent's photo at the same age.

yeni_okul.title: New school, new class
yeni_okul.text: You don't know anyone at your new school.

options.text: Introduce yourself to the person next to you
options.result: You had a friend by the first break.
A week later you'd figured out who's who.

ilk_harclik_kazanc.title: Your first earnings
ilk_harclik_kazanc.text: You washed a neighbor's car and they gave you 100 🪙.

options.text: Put it in the piggy bank
options.result: The first money you earned yourself. It feels different.
Just a small flower, but your mom's eyes filled with tears.

eski_ayakkabi.title: Worn-out shoes
eski_ayakkabi.text: The sole of your shoe has a hole; your socks get wet in the rain. There's no money at home for new ones.

options.text: Buy new ones with your own savings
options.result: Shoes bought with your own effort feel sturdier.
The cobbler resoled them; they'll last another winter.

options.text: Don't tell your family; make do
options.result: You didn't want to burden your family. But your health matters too.

kardes_kiyafeti.title: Hand-me-downs
kardes_kiyafeti.text: Instead of new clothes for the holiday, you got your older sibling's old ones.

options.text: Iron them nicely and wear them
options.result: Clean and neat, no one even noticed.
Your mom was hurt. When the budget is tight, everyone gives something up.

kis_komur.title: Cold winter
kis_komur.text: Winter came early and there wasn't enough money for firewood. Only one room in the house is warm.

options.result: Your hands got calloused, but the stove is lit.

options.text: The whole family gathers in one room
options.result: Stories by the stove, hot tea… Even hardship can't take away every beautiful moment.

veresiye.title: The shop tab
veresiye.text: Your mom sent you to the corner shop: "Ask them to put it on our tab." The shopkeeper says the tab is already very full.

options.text: Pay part of it with your pocket money
options.result: The shopkeeper patted your head: "You're a good kid."
Back home, you and your mom wrote the accounts on a sheet of paper.

anne_temizlik.title: Your mom works as a cleaner
anne_temizlik.text: To make ends meet, {anne} cleans other people's homes. She comes back exhausted every evening.

options.text: Warm up dinner and make her tea when she gets home
options.result: Your mom smiled: "My tiredness is gone."

options.text: Promise she won't have to work when you grow up
options.result: That promise will motivate you for years.

burs_fakir.title: Scholarship chance
burs_fakir.text: A foundation offers scholarships to high-achieving students with limited means. The deadline is tomorrow.

options.success: You won the scholarship! Books and transport are now covered.
options.fail: Not this time; you can apply again next year.

options.text: Tell yourself "I won't win" and don't apply
options.result: Those who never try never win.

servis_parasi.title: School bus fee
servis_parasi.text: The school bus fee went up. Your family is struggling to pay.

options.result: You get up early, but it's healthy and saves money.
The family budget got a little tighter.

kredi_taksit.title: Installments
kredi_taksit.text: Your family bought the car and the fridge in installments. The 15th of every month is tense at home.

options.text: Put your wishes on hold for a while
options.result: A mature attitude; your mom noticed.

options.text: Ask for a new game console
options.result: The request was denied, and silence fell over the house for a while.

kurs_mu_tatil_mi.title: Course or vacation?
kurs_mu_tatil_mi.text: This summer the budget covers either a course or a vacation. Your family left the choice to you.

options.result: In September you were the best prepared in class.
A week by the sea; the best photos in the family album.
Your family was surprised by your maturity.

orta_komsu.title: Building meeting
orta_komsu.text: The building's roof is leaking; repair costs are being discussed and everyone is arguing.

options.text: Gather everyone's views and propose a shared solution
options.success: The residents want to elect you as building manager!
options.fail: The meeting ended in a fight again.

options.result: The decision was made without you.

ozel_okul_baski.title: The weight of expectations
ozel_okul_baski.text: You're at an expensive private school. After every exam your family says, "We pay so much for this."

options.text: Talk to your family about expectations
options.success: For the first time they listened: "Your happiness matters too."
options.fail: The talk turned into an argument.

options.result: Your grades went up, but you can't sleep at night.

yalniz_zengin.title: Big house, empty house
yalniz_zengin.text: Your parents are always on business trips. You're alone in a huge house with your nanny.

options.text: Call them and say you miss them
options.result: Your father canceled his meeting the next day and came home.

options.text: Lose yourself in games and screens
options.result: A screen can't replace a hug.

options.text: Bake a cake with your nanny
options.result: Sometimes family isn't only about blood.

cikarci_arkadas.title: A real friend?
cikarci_arkadas.text: Your new "friends" always expect you to pay. When you suggested a free day out, no one came.

options.result: Few real friends beat many fake ones.
Your wallet got lighter, but not your loneliness.

simarik_testi.title: Everything you want
simarik_testi.text: Your family buys you "whatever you want". Even your school bag is the talk of the class.

options.text: Share part of your allowance with a classmate in need
options.result: Your friend thanked you with a look you'll never forget.
Jealousy and distance… Money doesn't buy respect.

yazin_yurtdisi.title: Summer camp abroad
yazin_yurtdisi.text: Your family wants to send you to a summer camp in England.

options.result: Two languages, friends from different cultures, a completely different summer.

options.text: I want to stay with my neighborhood friends
options.result: The best summer, spent in the dust of your own streets.

miras_kavgasi.title: Inheritance dispute
miras_kavgasi.text: There's tension between you and your siblings over the family company's future.

options.success: The siblings shook hands; family ties proved stronger than money.
options.fail: It didn't go to court, but holidays are now spent apart.

options.text: Give up your share; choose peace
options.result: The money is gone, but your siblings remain.

koy_dugun.title: Village wedding
koy_dugun.text: There's a three-day wedding in the village; drums and pipes everywhere.

options.result: Did you lead the dance or not? Everyone is talking about it.
Pots and pots of stew… The village elders praised you.

koy_hayvan.title: The cow is calving
koy_hayvan.text: Sounds from the barn at midnight; the cow is giving birth and struggling.

options.result: In the morning there was a calf in the barn on wobbly legs.
You and your grandpa helped the calf into the world.

sehir_trafik.title: City traffic
sehir_trafik.text: You spend two hours in traffic every day on your way to work.

options.text: Read or listen to podcasts on public transport
options.result: Travel time became time well spent.
The traffic didn't change; you just got tired.

sehir_kira.title: Big-city rent
sehir_kira.text: The landlord is hiking the rent. Rent in the city swallows half your salary.

options.result: Arguments over dishes, but money left in your pocket.
Your savings melted away.
The commute got longer, the rent lower.

kasaba_pazari.title: Town market
kasaba_pazari.text: At the weekly market everyone knows each other. An older lady left her stall in your care for five minutes.

options.text: Watch the stall and make a few sales
options.success: When she came back the till was exact, and she gave you some pocket money.
options.fail: You made a mistake or two, but she laughed: "That's how you learn trade."

options.result: You disappeared into the market crowd.

yeni_mudur.title: New manager
yeni_mudur.text: A new manager arrived at work and wants to change everything.

options.result: The manager cited your suggestion as an example in a meeting.
Things started a bit tense with the new manager.

is_arkadasi_yardim.title: A coworker's request
is_arkadasi_yardim.text: A coworker asks for your help to finish a report they're behind on.

options.result: One day they'll help you too.

options.text: Politely say you're busy with your own work
options.result: Setting boundaries is a skill too.

hata_yaptin.title: You made a mistake at work
hata_yaptin.text: You made a mistake on an important task; no one has noticed yet.

options.result: Your manager appreciated your honesty: "Everyone makes mistakes; few don't hide them."
When the mistake came out, things got even harder.

ise_gec.title: The alarm didn't go off
ise_gec.text: When you woke up you were already late for work.

options.result: They were understanding; it happens once.
The next day your lie came out.

zam_istegi.title: Time for a raise
zam_istegi.text: You worked hard all year, but your pay has fallen behind inflation.

options.text: Negotiate a raise with your manager
options.success: You got a raise close to what you asked for!
options.fail: "There's no budget right now," they said. Try again next year.

options.result: They didn't.

cocuk_okul_secimi.title: Your child's school
cocuk_okul_secimi.text: Your child is starting school. Public or private?

options.text: Public school, with support at home
options.result: Doing homework together in the evenings was good for both of you.
Expensive, but you chose it while you could.

cocuk_zorbalik.title: Your child is being bullied
cocuk_zorbalik.text: You realized your child is being bullied at school; they came home crying.

options.text: Listen and solve it together with the school
options.result: The school acted at once; your child learned they can tell you anything.
It escalated and your child was punished. Violence isn't the answer.

cocuk_ergenlik.title: The teen behind the closed door
cocuk_ergenlik.text: Your teenager won't leave their room and answers questions in one word.

options.result: A game you played together became a bridge between you.
The door closed even tighter.

cocuk_basari.title: Proud of your child
cocuk_basari.text: Your child won an award at school; they read their name on stage.

options.result: Life's sweetest applause was the one for your child.

cocuk_universite.title: Your child is at university
cocuk_universite.text: Your child got into a university in another city. Dorm and allowance costs begin.

options.result: On the phone they said, "I'm so glad I have you."

options.text: Let them stand on their own with a scholarship and part-time job
options.result: A hard but educational path.

komsu_gurultu.title: Noisy neighbor
komsu_gurultu.text: The upstairs neighbor seems to be moving furniture at midnight. You can't sleep.

options.result: Turns out they'd just moved in; the next day they came to apologize with dessert.

options.text: Bang on the ceiling with a broom
options.result: A cold war began in the building.

eski_sevgili.title: Someone from the past
eski_sevgili.text: An old acquaintance messaged you on social media: "How are you? Want to grab a coffee?"

options.text: Tell your spouse and set a clear boundary
options.result: Trust is the foundation of a relationship.
Secrets make the air at home heavy.

spor_bayram.title: Charity run
spor_bayram.text: The city is holding a charity run; every kilometer funds a student's scholarship.

options.result: At the finish line you got your medal and a photo of a scholarship.
Even without running, you contributed.

kursa_yazil.title: Evening course
kursa_yazil.text: The community education center opened its new term.

options.result: Being a student again after years felt good.
Creating something with your hands is like therapy.
Maybe next year.

doktor_kontrol_40.title: Check-up at 40
doktor_kontrol_40.text: Your doctor recommends regular check-ups after forty: blood pressure, sugar, cholesterol.

options.text: Get checked and follow the advice
options.result: High cholesterol caught early came down with walking.
Silent problems grow silently.

is_kaybi.title: The company is downsizing
is_kaybi.text: Your company is going through hard times; a list is being prepared and your name is being discussed.

options.text: Show your performance and give a presentation
options.success: You weren't on the list — and they gave you new responsibilities.
options.fail: You were laid off and got your severance. You'll need to look for a new job.

options.text: Resign and look for a new path with severance
options.result: Uncertainty is scary, but when one door closes another opens.

emeklilik_hobisi.title: A new pastime in retirement
emeklilik_hobisi.text: Retirement means plenty of time. What will you do?

options.result: Peace at the end of a line in the morning mist.

options.text: Organize a chess tournament at the local café
options.result: You became the neighborhood's chess master.
A child read their first book by your side.

torun_bakimi.title: Grandchild care
torun_bakimi.text: Your child works and asks you to look after your grandchild on weekdays.

options.result: Days in the park with your grandchild are the best of your life.
Balance is good.

yasli_yalnizlik.title: A quiet house
yasli_yalnizlik.text: The children grew up and left. The house has gone quiet.

options.text: Gather old friends for a dinner
options.result: Laughter around the table; old age doesn't mean loneliness.
"Mom/Dad, we're coming this weekend!"

saglik_yaslilik.title: Knee pain
saglik_yaslilik.text: Your knees struggle on the stairs now.

options.text: Start physical therapy and walk regularly
options.result: In a few months the stairs became your friend again.
Inactivity made the pain even worse.

vasiyet_aile.title: Family heirloom
vasiyet_aile.text: You're deciding which child should get the old watch your grandfather left you.

options.text: Give it to the youngest along with its story
options.result: The watch, with its story, will live on for another generation.
It's displayed in the local museum with your name.

teknoloji_yasli.title: Smartphone lesson
teknoloji_yasli.text: Your grandchild wants to teach you how to make video calls.

options.result: Now you video-call every evening!
The world is changing; keeping up is hard but not impossible.

biz_viral.title: Your product took off!
biz_viral.text: One of your products spread on social media; orders are up tenfold. You can't keep up.

options.text: Take a loan and scale up production
options.result: You took a big gamble…
options.success: The growth paid off! Your profits will multiply for the next two years.
options.fail: The trend faded overnight; you were left with loan debt and excess stock.

options.text: Take pre-orders and keep the quality
options.result: Customers waited but were happy. Solid growth.
Good money short-term, but some customers were put off.

biz_ortak_teklif.title: Partnership offer
biz_ortak_teklif.text: An old acquaintance says "I bring the capital, you bring the work" and wants to partner. Smooth-talking, but with a murky past.

options.result: You shook hands…
options.success: They turned out to be an honest partner; the business grew.
options.fail: One morning the till was empty and your partner was gone. A harsh lesson.

options.text: Sign a notarized contract first, then partner
options.result: The contract protected you; the partnership started on solid ground.
Caution is sometimes the best investment.

biz_ihale.title: Big tender
biz_ihale.text: The city has a big supply tender. Win it and the year's profit multiplies, but you must put down a deposit.

options.result: The envelopes were opened…
options.success: You won the tender! The biggest job of the year.
options.fail: The tender went to another firm; part of your deposit went on costs.

options.text: Listen to the middleman offering a bribe
options.result: You took a dark path…
options.success: You won, but an unease stayed with you.
options.fail: An investigation was opened; your business took a heavy blow.

options.result: You focused on your own customers.

biz_kur_soku.title: Currency shock
biz_kur_soku.text: The exchange rate jumped in a week. Suppliers won't quote prices; the goods on your shelves gained value, but restocking is hard.

options.text: Sell the stock now and go to cash
options.result: Cash in hand, but the shelves are empty.

options.text: Hold the stock; prices will rise further
options.result: You started waiting…
options.success: Your bet paid off; the stock was worth its weight in gold.
options.fail: The rate came back and demand collapsed; you were stuck with the goods.

options.result: Costs rose a bit, but business didn't stop.

biz_depo_yangin.title: Warehouse fire
biz_depo_yangin.text: The phone rang at midnight: there's a fire at your warehouse.

options.result: Insurance covered most of the loss. Good thing you had it.
A hard year, but your business survived.

options.text: Scale down and save what's left
options.result: You dropped a level but didn't sink into debt.

biz_alacak.title: Big order on credit
biz_alacak.text: A large company wants to order three times your usual volume on six-month payment terms.

options.result: You delivered the goods…
options.success: The payment came on time. A great year!
options.fail: The company filed for bankruptcy protection; you never got paid.

options.text: Offer a discount for payment up front
options.result: You earned less, but the money is in your pocket.
You stayed away from the risk.

biz_sigorta.title: Business insurance
biz_sigorta.text: An insurance agent suggests insuring your business against fire, theft and earthquakes.

options.result: Now most losses from fire and theft will be covered.
You carry the risk yourself.

biz_rakip.title: A rival opened next door
biz_rakip.text: A well-funded rival opened right next to you, with opening-special prices.

options.result: You slashed prices…
options.success: The rival couldn't hold on and closed.
options.fail: They had deep pockets; you were worn down.

options.text: Stand out with service and quality
options.result: Your loyal customers stuck with you.

biz_yeni_urun.title: Testing a new product
biz_yeni_urun.text: You have an idea for a new product. Trying it takes some capital.

options.text: Test it with a small batch
options.result: You put the product on the shelf…
options.success: It took off! It's flying off the shelves.
options.fail: People didn't like it; a small loss, a good lesson.

options.result: You wrote the idea in your notebook.

biz_kira.title: Rent increase
biz_kira.text: The landlord wants to double the rent, or you're out.

options.result: You kept your spot, but your margin shrank.
Some of your customers couldn't find you at the new place.
You sat down at the table…
options.success: You agreed on a reasonable increase.
options.fail: The landlord wouldn't budge.
